entries.353ad7916c76b425: Under “Decisive Reform,” which it has pursued since 2019, the company is promoting a shift from a flow-type business centered on trading commissions to a “stock-type business model” centered on stable income such as trust fees for investment trusts and wrap fees, with customers' interests first. From April 2026, it has started its new medium-term management plan “Target 5 <ONE TEAM>,” and states that it will pursue growth centered on expanding assets under custody and make advance investments in people, AI and DX.
